snippet.title: Silent Hunt   Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST Silent Hunt on steam ! : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607330/Silent_Hunt/

In Silent Hunt you play as a police officer sent to a remote island in British Columbia. Investigate disappearances on Mist Island. Explore the island on foot or by car. Hide, fight and survive the threat that lurks in the forest. Protect the local population and put an end to the vicious dinosaurs !

Synopsis :
Port Charles, British Columbia has been plagued by disapereances in the last months. You are sent with your colleague, Lt. Murdoch, to investigate missing people and bring back trust in this isolated community. Explore the island, investigate the clue, find the killer and neutralise him !  

If you enjoy my content, and want to support game development, the best things you can do would be wishlisting the game on steam to help us grow and subscribe to the channel. I have a newsletter to stay tuned about game development !

Check Silent Hunt playlist :    • Silent Hunt Reveal Teaser - New Dinosaur S...  

Subscribe to our newsletter : subscribepage.io/baronrougestudio !

Thanks everyone!
-Boris Differ (Void Rouge Studio)
